# Pricing Page Monitor

> Extract competitor price points from pricing pages and detect when they change.

- Actor: data_foundry/pricing-page-monitor
- URL: https://apify.com/data_foundry/pricing-page-monitor
- Publisher: Data Foundry (https://apify.com/data_foundry)
- Category: Monitoring
- Pricing: $2.00 per 1,000 URLs scanned; pay per event, no subscription, failures not billed
- Input: pricing page URLs
- Output: price sets, new and removed prices, a change signal
- Run: apify call data_foundry/pricing-page-monitor
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_foundry~pricing-page-monitor/runs
- More actors: https://apify.com/data_foundry
